theorems.name: Submission.bf_orthStabilizer_haar_exists
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), ∃ θ : Measure (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), IsProbabilityMeasure θ ∧ (∀ᵐ g ∂θ, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g * g = 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, g x = x) ∧ ∀ k : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint k * k = 1 → (∀ x ∈ U, k x = x) → Measure.map (fun g ↦ k * g) θ = θ ∧ Measure.map (fun g ↦ g * k) θ = θ
